transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. I guess... it's mostly just some issues at work. I keep starting things, like the sanitation steps or the batch logs... the end-of-line paperwork. But I somehow just leave out the last parts. Even when I know my job depends on finishing them correctly, I just... yeah. That's why I'm here.

When you are working on these tasks, do you feel an overwhelming need to perform them in a very specific, ritualized way, or do you feel like you have to repeat them because of a persistent, distressing thought?
No... I don't think so. It's not really a ritual or... anything like that. I just don't finish them.
Do you find that you struggle with this same kind of difficulty staying focused or finishing tasks in other areas of your life, such as at home or with personal errands?
Um... I guess so. Yeah. It's... it happens at home, too. I just... I don't know, I just don't get things done.
Aside from the trouble finishing tasks, have you been feeling sad, hopeless, or uninterested in activities you usually enjoy?
No... I don't think so. I'm not sad or anything. It's just... the stuff I mentioned.
Do you often feel physically restless or like you have a sense of dread or tension that you just can't seem to shake off?
No... I don't really get like that. I don't feel tense or... restless. It's just what I said before.
Do you often find yourself becoming easily distracted by things around you, or do you frequently lose things like your keys or phone because you forget where you put them?

Yeah... I lose things. A lot, I guess. Mostly at work. I'm always losing things I need on the floor... like my cut glove, or my marker. My badge and safety glasses, too. I'll swear I just had them right in my hand... and then I have to spend ten minutes retracing my steps to find them.
Looking back at your time in school, did you struggle with finishing your assignments or keeping track of your belongings back then, or is this a newer issue for you?

It's... not a new thing. My mom actually still has some of my old report cards from around fourth grade. They'd say I was bright, but... I always needed constant reminders to finish my classwork and turn in my homework. I remember understanding the lessons fine, I just... I would miss chunks of the instructions unless the teacher stayed right by me.
